topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
consensus_response: Increasing array size leads to higher insertion loss, reducing radiation efficiency. Optimal design balances array size with feeding topology and materials to minimize losses while maintaining compact configurations, impacting network capacity and link quality.
reference_context: SIW arrays face trade-offs between size, gain, and efficiency, with larger arrays experiencing higher insertion loss and reduced radiation efficiency.
